workers.title: Bound native Go judge child runtime without changing transport semantics
workers.done_when: For Git-backed Go checks in runCommandCheck, launch the child through exec.CommandContext with a fixed bounded runtime, a safe Cancel that calls the existing terminateLearningProcessTree ONLY on that exact owned cmd.Process, and a short WaitDelay; receipt must include deadline_utc, remain RUNNING after a caller transport timeout while process lives, and become terminal FAILED with actual exit and SHA after a true runtime deadline. Non-Go checks and runScriptCheck retain prior behavior; logical judge PASS/FAIL display name unchanged and n123GoJudgeOperation source+args key unchanged. No CLI update/install or foreign PID kill.
workers.instructions: ONLY EDIT cmd/judge.go. Inspect existing runCommandCheck which builds newChildCommand(resolved, chk.Args...), sets Dir/env, then calls runReceipted(context.Background(),scope,'judge',n123GoJudgeOperation(...),cmd). Replace only the Go path with an opt-in bounded `context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), n123GoJudgeMaxDuration)` (prefer variable 4m for narrow test seam) and `exec.CommandContext` using same sanitized childEnvironment/explicit environment behavior; register `cmd.Cancel = func() error { return terminateLearningProcessTree(cmd) }` and `cmd.WaitDelay=3*time.Second`. This helper is already native, scoped to the PID; do NOT call taskkill directly or invent bridge; do NOT change generic runReceipted semantics, stdout, source identity or non-Go checks. Detect Go before spawn via `isGoCommand(resolved)`; fail closed if env can't be set; call `runReceipted(ctx,...)`, explicitly cancel afterwards. No global env/permissions/PLAN edits. Keep a small localized code diff; do not run full Go suite.

workers.title: Prove bounded Go judge source-only timeout and terminal receipt using an owned child fixture
workers.done_when: A deterministic focused Go test on an owned disposable fixture proves an executable named go.exe is launched through the source-only native Go judge with bounded deadline_utc, times out as a FAILED/UNKNOWN (never PASS), and its own owned child process terminates and seals immutable exit/output SHA, while existing transport short-timeout tests remain unchanged; non-Go operation behavior is preserved. Must never kill foreign processes or rely on shell UAC.
workers.instructions: ONLY EDIT cmd/judge_observe_test.go. Add a Windows-specific small helper-process fixture using t.TempDir and an isolated git commit so `n123GoJudgeOperation` has HEAD, copy the current test executable to `<t.TempDir>/go.exe` (or similar isolated basename), and have it run a special `-test.run` helper that deliberately waits past a short test timeout from a temporary value of `n123GoJudgeMaxDuration` (restore with t.Cleanup). Use `runCommandCheck` (not a direct command) to trigger the *actual* native Go judge path; inspect immutable receipt and output with `inspectOwnedJob` or readJobReceipt by operation key, expect no PASS, real deadline_utc, eventual terminal FAILED and nonempty output SHA, and no duplicate start. Tests should be ~2 seconds (bounded poll), no arbitrary process termination outside own code. Do not change runtime files, PLAN or other tests; don't run full Go suite. If environment disallows taskkill own process, test should report NOT_PROVEN and preserve logs, not silently PASS.
